agent_priors_used: General prior, not SPIDER evidence: locally rational continuation is a documented failure mode; a lane left on its own next_question drifts toward incremental refinements of a spent thread.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: if comparators sit at ceiling, no treatment effect is identifiable regardless of sample size, so a non-degeneracy/dynamic-range check must precede any benchmark spend.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: end-to-end agent cost is dominated by exploration, verification and repair rather than by stored-representation size, which favors counter-based work-avoided metrics.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: memory/cache invalidation is harder than population and un-questioned stale knowledge is a correctness hazard, so false-accept-first freshness/repair metrics matter more than coverage.
General prior, not SPIDER evidence: a prerequisite observed failing identically across lanes should be repaired once, not rediscovered per lane - but only if it is reachable by an authorized writer.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: serial gating chains make off-path breadth cheap but not free; off-path lanes should be parked or pointed at the highest-value non-gated question rather than kept busy.

allocation.question: Can a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified arithmetically BEFORE freeze - cold re-derivation and a retrieval-shaped comparator demonstrably below ceiling at high residual novelty, a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction, honest per-condition counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate - and be delivered as a reusable substrate on the lane and/or shipped path that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (blocker B2)?
allocation.rationale: Runtime is tunnel-flagged with a 68-streak on C-MEAS-VALID, but the flag is largely a label artifact: the active mandate has moved the object of study from the substrate oracle to the B2 task bank, which is on the critical path. B2 is a hard prerequisite for the one decisive benchmark, and without a task bank whose cold and retrieval-shaped comparators are provably below ceiling, any treatment effect remains unidentifiable regardless of sample size. The active mandate also requires delivery as a reusable substrate, which is exactly what Graph and Physics are blocked on for real-drift questions. The composite-oracle repair proposed in the lane's parent handoff is deliberately not re-promoted to primary: it unblocks only lower-priority out-of-surface drift work that the audit already scoped down, and the previous cycle correctly superseded it with B2. A cognitive reset on today's Codex keeps B2 as the highest-value Runtime objective.

(2) I accept its challenge to Frontier's C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE pivot and pivot Frontier to the acquisition-cost / site-native-discovery question; I reject its alternative orthogonal probes because structured intent canonicalization duplicates C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, incremental/delta propagation duplicates the C-DELTA-REPAIR work I am assigning to Graph, and compile-then-replay is close to SPIDER's own core and to the withdrawn 8.5x replay claim. I also answer its open question about the shared freeze-time code-binding defect by NOT assigning any lane to repair it (scripts/ is outside every lane's allowed code roots) and by writing mandates that avoid the unsatisfiable V9 literal. Its external notes on budget-matched memory negatives, stale-memory benchmarks and strong browser-agent baselines are recorded as design priors for the eventual flagship benchmark, not as SPIDER evidence.
